newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana Commercial Bank boosts Accra bourse.
newsitem.headline: Ghana Commercial Bank boosts Accra bourse.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share index rose on Monday, with Ghana Commercial Bank (+20 cedis to 600 cedis) leading the way, its market report showed.
The index rose 2.26 points to 365.14 points.
The index had risen 5.16 points on Friday to close the week at 362.88 points.
A total of 42,470 shares changed hands with bids outstripping offers by 7,134,170 to 366,370.
Other risers were consumer products company UNILEVER (+3 to 835), trading company CFAO Ghana (+1 to 20), Enterprise Insurance Company (+1 to 486) and Home Finance Company (+1 to 141)
The lone declining issue was pharmaceutical and trading company Paterson Zochonis, which fell 10 cedis to 250, after falling 55 on Friday.
